t: You're on Lexham Gardens, a street in South Kensington. It's best known here as the birthplace of the actor Denholm Elliott. Elliott had a long career on stage and screen, and won three BAFTAs for best supporting actor, for Trading Places, A Private Function and Defence of the Realm. He was also nominated for an Oscar for A Room with a View. Many people will know him as Marcus Brody in the Indiana Jones films.
